feature.description: Generate a minimal backend feature library at libs/backend/features/<name>.

entity.description: Generate a Mongo-backed backend entity library at libs/backend/features/<name>, with an optional REST controller (--crud).

mongo.description: Install the optional Mongo brick: connects libs/backend/database/mongo to the API app.

auth.description: Install the optional JWT auth brick: connects libs/backend/auth to the API app.

security.description: Install the optional HTTP security brick (Helmet, CORS, rate limiting) into the API app.

health.description: Install the optional liveness healthcheck (GET /health/live) into the API app.
